research_question: Which external mechanisms can help Frankenstein 2.0 stop unproductive cognition or interaction early without confusing STOP/HOLD with canonical task completion and without losing useful progress?

candidates.name: AgentExit

source.paper: Runaway is Ashamed, But Helpful: On the Early-Exit Behavior of Large Language Model-based Agents in Embodied Environments

mechanism: intrinsic exit instructions inside agent generation
extrinsic task-completion verifier used to decide when a trial halts
Redundancy Steps and Progress Degradation as paired efficiency-versus-damage metrics
handoff to a stronger agent after early exit as a bounded continuation strategy
candidates.upstream_claims_only: Across four LLMs and five embodied environments the authors report fewer redundant steps with minor performance degradation; a stronger-agent continuation can recover/improve performance within a fixed step budget.
candidates.f2_hypothesis: A distilled early-exit controller with explicit progress-loss measurement can reduce WP509 rumination while routing uncertain exits to HOLD/ASK/DELEGATE/re-observe instead of minting COMPLETE.
candidates.counterhypothesis: AgentExit's embodied-task completion verifier may be too environment-specific and may encourage premature disengagement when translated to heterogeneous F2 work.
candidates.authority_fence: Any verifier output is a stop/hold/delegate candidate only. It cannot create canonical completion, effect success or world truth.

candidates.name: REFRAIN

source.paper: Stop When Enough: Adaptive Early-Stopping for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

mechanism: adaptive stop threshold conditioned on observed problem difficulty
candidates.upstream_claims_only: The ACL paper reports 20-55% token reduction while maintaining or improving accuracy across four benchmarks and two model families.
candidates.f2_hypothesis: SW-UCB-style online threshold adaptation is a strong structural donor for WP509 expected-value stopping and WP505 adaptive compute allocation because it learns a bounded stop policy from recent utility rather than a fixed token/step threshold.
candidates.counterhypothesis: CoT redundancy signals may not transfer to agentic action loops, and any semantic stop discriminator may be noisy or circular when the same model judges its own cognition.
candidates.authority_fence: Bandit reward must come from measured downstream outcome/progress/resource signals where available; model self-confidence alone cannot become canonical stopping truth.

candidates.name: Overthinking evaluation framework

source.paper: The Danger of Overthinking: Examining the Reasoning-Action Dilemma in Agentic Tasks

mechanism: failure taxonomy: Analysis Paralysis, Rogue Actions, Premature Disengagement
candidates.upstream_claims_only: The paper analyzes 4,018 trajectories and reports that selecting lower-overthinking solutions can improve performance by almost 30% while reducing computational cost by 43% in its studied setting.
candidates.f2_hypothesis: The taxonomy is a better WP509/WP800 falsifier donor than a runtime controller: F2 should measure both rumination and premature stopping, not optimize only for shorter traces.
candidates.counterhypothesis: A score calibrated on SWE-bench trajectories may not transfer to F2's multimodal, persistent and delegated workloads.
candidates.authority_fence: A low overthinking score is not task completion or action correctness.

candidates.name: State Machine Reasoning (SMR)

source.paper: From Token to Action: State Machine Reasoning to Mitigate Overthinking in Information Retrieval

mechanism: explicit state transitions instead of unrestricted token-level reasoning
early validation plus bounded maximum step count
candidates.upstream_claims_only: The paper reports +3.4% nDCG@10 and 74.4% token reduction on BEIR/BRIGHT.
candidates.f2_hypothesis: The transferable part is explicit transition-level STOP with measurable state improvement, not the IR-specific retriever stack.
candidates.counterhypothesis: F2 already has explicit ACT/ASK/WAIT/HOLD/DELEGATE transitions, so importing SMR code would duplicate the control plane and add an Ollama/retrieval-specific dependency surface.
candidates.authority_fence: STOP remains a policy transition, not completion authority.

candidates.name: ASAG

source.paper: Stop When Further Reasoning Won't Help: Attention-State Adaptive Generation in Reasoning Models

candidates.mechanism: training-free early stopping from attention-distribution state with adaptive generation control
candidates.upstream_claims_only: The paper reports about 3.2% average accuracy improvement and nearly 40% fewer generated tokens on Qwen3-8B across nine reasoning benchmarks.
candidates.f2_hypothesis: Useful later for local/open-weight model-specific WP505/WP509 control when attention states are observable.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Opaque hosted models do not expose the required attention state and model-specific hidden-state signals can create a brittle nonportable control dependency.
candidates.authority_fence: Attention-state evidence is model-specific measurement, never canonical world or completion truth.

primary_measurement_package: false COMPLETE rate = must remain zero by construction
fusion_result.proposed_f2_design_hypothesis: WP509 should evaluate marginal expected information/progress gain rather than raw reasoning length. When marginal value is low, it emits a typed transition among HOLD, WAIT, ASK, DELEGATE, REOBSERVE or STOP_COGNITION; canonical COMPLETE remains a separate evidence-gated state. Thresholds may adapt from recent measured outcomes using a bounded bandit-style controller, while hard maximum-step/time/resource fences remain deterministic fallbacks.
fusion_result.serious_counterhypothesis: A deterministic small rule set using repeated-state detection, no-new-evidence counters and hard budgets may capture most benefit with lower latency, fewer self-evaluation errors and simpler causal attribution than any learned/bandit stop controller.
fusion_result.cheapest_high_information_discriminator: On a deterministic held-out agent-loop fixture, compare (A) hard-budget/repetition baseline, (B) AgentExit-style progress-aware stop policy, and (C) B plus bounded adaptive thresholding. Measure redundant steps, progress degradation, false completion, recovery via ASK/DELEGATE/re-observe, token/wall-time cost and causal trace integrity. Do not promote to E4 until an admitted execution surface exists and the exact F2 baseline is bound.
